rules.condition_explanation: personal_educational_or_study_use means the material is used for personal study or learning. reference_for_own_projects means it is used as a reference for the licensee's own projects. attribution_visible is the obligation stated at lines 39–42.

rules.source_excerpt: 1. REDISTRIBUIR este material, no todo ou em parte, por qualquer meio

obligation_items.content: Do not redistribute the material, in whole or in part, by any means.
obligation_items.object: the material, in whole or in part

rules.condition_explanation: Public sharing in any of the listed venues is prohibited.

obligation_items.content: Do not share the material publicly in repositories, websites, social networks, or forums.
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever the licensee would share the material publicly in a listed venue.

rules.source_excerpt: 3. VENDER ou utilizar comercialmente este material
rules.scope_note: License terms, prohibited-use list: selling the material. The distinct commercial-use prohibition is extracted separately.
rules.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies when the licensee sells the material.

rules.source_excerpt: 3. VENDER ou utilizar comercialmente este material

obligation_items.content: Do not use the material commercially.

rules.source_excerpt: 4. REMOVER ou alterar os avisos de autoria e licença
rules.scope_note: License terms, prohibited-use list: removing or altering authorship and license notices.
rules.condition_explanation: The prohibition covers either removing or altering the material's authorship or license notices.

obligation_items.content: Do not remove or alter the material's authorship or license notices.

obligation_items.trigger: Whenever the licensee would remove or alter such a notice.

rules.source_excerpt: 5. CRIAR obras derivadas para distribuição pública

obligation_items.content: Do not distribute derivative works publicly.
obligation_items.object: a derivative work of the material
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever the licensee would distribute the derivative work publicly.

rules.condition_explanation: express_written_authorization_from_author means express authorization from the author in written form; the exception applies to inclusion in any of the listed educational materials.

obligation_items.content: Do not include the material in courses, trainings, or teaching materials without the author's express written authorization.
